name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: An accordion whose panel unfolds downward while each row enters as the growing edge reaches it. Closing lets the rows leave first, then folds the panel.
author: ARLing s. r. o. (https://arling.sk)
docs:
Accordion from ARLing Motion (MIT).
React: import { Accordion, AccordionItem } from "@/components/ui/motion-accordion".
The logic is in lib/arling-motion-accordion.js (typed by the .d.ts next to it) and works without React: createAccordion on your own markup.
Styles were added to your global CSS under @layer components (Tailwind v4).
With Tailwind v3 or no Tailwind, add https://arling.sk/motion/components/accordion/accordion.css to your styles instead.
Live demo and docs: https://arling.sk/motion/#accordion
